verdict.rationale: Llama docs briefly assert 'function calling and agent-optimized inference' for Llama 3.1+, but no evidence details typed tool-definition schemas, parallel/multi-step call semantics, or an agent-loop walkthrough. A direct probe further shows the overview/get-started docs are gated behind an SSO wall rather than publicly readable, undermining the claim that this is 'documented well enough' for an outside developer. missing for 10: concrete tool-calling schema/spec, parallel & multi-step call examples, publicly accessible agent-loop documentation, independent hands-on confirmation.
